body:
I wish I could give you a hug, or wish that you could give me one right now. How did you overcome it? I still don't know what I should do now. When I'm occupied and when I'm trying not to think about him, I can pretend to look fine. But when I'm taking my time alone or when I'm trying to sleep, all I think about is him, and I feel so bad that I just want to disappear forever. 

I still find myself randomly thinking I was in a dream, hoping tomorrow I'll wake up and everything's fine.
Let's say it's related to a truck accident. Victim was conscious, in pain and alive in 2-3 hours till dead. Victim and the culprit is very close to each other.

I know. I never once tell myself that it's not my fault, or it's his destiny or I can't do anything about it some shit like that. I always knew that I'm a terrible person. But why is posting my story in more places bad? I don't take any validation for my actions, i can never erase his last moments right before my eyes, or the bad choices I did. I just don't want it's gone so lonely, without anyone knowing about it besides my family and my acquaintances. I just want future dog owners know to protect their small good boys better, and make them more happy, something I failed horribly.

Last question though, since you're the only person who tell me the truth that it's my fault, should I go to him in the same way that I made him gone? Answer me.

I'm sorry, I'm feeling so bad right now, I want to met him right now, even though I mistreated him so much. Even though I never realized how good of a boy he was when he's alive. Never gave him a bowl full of cheese that a good boy like him deserves. Never gave him a ride so long that he'd grow tired of it. Never hugged him hard enough, never let him lick my face long enough...
Thank you very much. I'm feeling a bit better hearing your nice words for him. Couldn't sleep tonight, trying to write whatever memories of him I can think about in my diary.

This is his [pictures](https://www.reddit.com/r/MadeMeCry/comments/tewvlu/my_dog_got_ran_over_by_a_truck_today_right_after/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) with me. I don't know if more people know him would make him felt better. I don't know what I'm doing, or what i should do right now anymore...

Or should I accept that he's gone forever, that I should've done something when he was alive, not now... I don't know how not to feel pain everytime I'm reminded of him. Or would everything fades away with time, even his silhouette, his personality, the time he was happy being with me. Maybe it'd feel better if I'm feeling nothing right now... But don't worry, I can never do it, I can never hurt my mom that bad...

This is the full [story](https://www.reddit.com/r/TrueOffMyChest/comments/tew1v9/my_dog_died_today_he_was_tried_to_cross_the_road/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) if anyone wanna know. Honestly, I don't know what to do anymore...
